0ae46268-cca7-57d5-a0ee-6eb3b85cda84.content: Calculate user study compensation budgets based on estimated participation burden, combining session time and preparation effort.

bdda6e22-ea06-5a13-8854-67f7521724db.content: Compensate for required travel time in face-to-face user studies as well.

f49b1d0a-7a1a-53b5-b7fc-815cc2cc134a.content: Compensate for the actual time participants spent in sessions, regardless of research modality.

1f4d05e4-2a79-572c-8050-beb1464fb781.content: Leave cash payment as an available compensation method for face-to-face studies.

abcba764-6f35-5dae-bb3d-7860fb72ccf2.content: If compensation equity is explained, do not require finalizing the payment method at the proposal stage.

c6a28f37-1a7c-5dbd-b75c-c829f0461504.content: Apply the same base hourly rate to face-to-face and remote studies if task burden is equal.

874de649-9c04-5960-b3a9-e68356ef666c.content: Participants judge compensation fairness based on the total burden, combining session time with required travel and preparation time.

529559f5-850d-5920-8e27-0b1e7138dc36.content: Account in compensation for the burden of rescheduling iterations and returning for multiple formative evaluation sessions.

c8be56ee-860a-5f6c-abbf-02c8dbc59eb5.content: Compensate participants for time already invested even if a session is terminated early due to prototype errors.

bdac8cf8-dd11-5794-b4b2-9774ff344436.content: The author of this proposal tends to exclude preparation burden between sessions when calculating compensation for iterative studies.
